name: AutoBattler
description: Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.3.0: keeps ranged standoff, fells trees/eats fruit when hurt, 2-ply lookahead planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
